field_edits.updated_text: Calcaneal spur is noted. No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion is seen.
Multiple joint spaces are reduced with marginal osteophyte formation and subchondral degenerative changes. No dislocation.

impression:
1. Multicompartmental degenerative osteoarthritic changes with multiple reduced joint spaces, marginal osteophyte formation and subchondral degenerative changes.
2. Calcaneal spur at the plantar aspect of the calcaneus.
3. No acute osseous abnormality.
